intent: Represents a single client command as it flows through Bedrock's prePeek/peek/process/postProcess pipeline, tracking plugin ownership, HTTPS sub-requests, per-phase timing, timeout policy, and crash-diagnostic state.

objects.name: BedrockCommand
objects.role: extends SQLiteCommand; the per-request unit of work with virtual peek/process hooks for plugins to override

objects.name: BedrockCommand::TIMING_INFO
objects.role: phase labels for timing samples, including BLOCKING_* variants for the blocking commit thread

objects.name: BedrockCommand::STAGE
objects.role: which pipeline stage reset() is being called for

objects.name: BedrockCommand::GrowOnlyList<T>
objects.role: append-only wrapper around list<T> (no erase); holds httpsRequests so iterators stay stable

objects.name: BedrockCommand::CrashMap
objects.role: subset of request name/value pairs used to fingerprint commands that may have caused a crash

misfits.why: a generic, command-agnostic container template with no dependency on BedrockCommand, defined inline inside it
special-cases a 'returnValueList' suffix documented in-code as a hack to support one legacy plugin format (Auth's old Get), inside the generic base command class
a sizeable timing-metrics/logging routine (per-phase totals, upstream-value promotion, a long SINFO composition) bundled into the command class itself rather than a separate metrics helper

location_fit.note: top-level, consistent with other core command-pipeline types (BedrockCore, BedrockServer)

naming_quality.note: consistent `_` on non-public members; TIMING_INFO is a plain unscoped enum sitting beside STAGE, which correctly uses enum class
